trigger_condition: Single-Track Tunnel Blockage on Double-Track Line
interlocking_rule: Opposite track operated bi-directionally between adjacent crossovers (e.g. Y33 to Y38); line capacity cut by 70%
Line split into northern double-track loop (Y29-Y38) and isolated southern shuttle (Y39-Y01); transfer forced at Y38

trigger_condition: Crossover / Switch Machine Failure at Critical Junction
headway_capability_s: No capacity reduction on straight path
interlocking_rule: Crossover locked in normal straight position; all short-turn loops suspended; through trains run normally
Trains switch to discrete axle-counter virtual block protection; minimum headway widens from 90s to 240s
Train uses onboard auxiliary battery to move to nearest platform; train then deboarded within 5 minutes
